behaviors.description: recipes.grouper(iterable, n) groups items into tuples of length n; for positive n the default incomplete='fill' pads the final group with None.
With incomplete='fill', recipes.grouper pads an incomplete final group with the supplied fillvalue.
With incomplete='ignore', recipes.grouper does not emit an incomplete final group.
With incomplete='strict', consuming recipes.grouper raises a ValueError subclass for an incomplete final group; complete groups remain valid.
recipes.roundrobin yields one item from each iterable in turn, continuing with the remaining iterables when an input is exhausted.
